en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayoub, from Abu Ubeyda, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Aliasws, whenever heasws found two men in one quilt, naked, would whip both of them the Penalty (Hadd) of the adultery, one hundred lashes, each one of them, and similarly for the two women if they were both found to be in one quilt, naked, would whip each one of them one hundred lashes’.
